WITH ranked_schools AS (
    SELECT
        cds,
        sname,
        cname,
        AvgScrRead,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY cname
            ORDER BY AvgScrRead DESC
        ) AS rank_num
    FROM satscores
    WHERE rtype = 'S'
      AND AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT rs.sname
FROM ranked_schools rs
JOIN schools sc ON rs.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE rs.rank_num <= 5
  AND LOWER(COALESCE(sc.Virtual, '')) IN ('y', 'yes', 'true', '1', 'virtual')
ORDER BY rs.cname, rs.sname;

  FROM schools
  WHERE AdmFName1 IS NOT NULL AND AdmFName1 <> ''

FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

SELECT COUNT(a.account_id)
FROM account AS a
JOIN district AS d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM loan AS l
        WHERE l.account_id = a.account_id
          AND l.status <> 'A'
  );

SELECT
  AVG(A12) AS avg_unemployment_1995,
  AVG(A13) AS avg_unemployment_1996,
  CASE WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END AS higher_year
FROM district;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM district WHERE A11 > 6000 AND A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND LOWER(d.A3) = 'north bohemia'
  AND d.A11 > 8000;

SELECT a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(d2.A11) - MIN(d2.A11) FROM district AS d2) AS salary_gap
FROM account AS a
JOIN disp AS dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN client AS c ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district AS d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(c2.birth_date) FROM client AS c2 WHERE c2.gender = 'F')
  AND d.A11 = (SELECT MIN(d3.A11) FROM district AS d3);

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account AS a
JOIN disp AS d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client AS c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district AS di ON c.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
  AND di.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)
ORDER BY a.account_id;

SELECT COUNT(client.client_id)
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.type = 'DISPONENT';

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account AS a
JOIN loan AS l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.status = 'A'
  AND (substr(l.date, 1, 4) = '1997' OR substr(l.date, 1, 2) = '97')
  AND (LOWER(a.frequency) LIKE '%week%' OR a.frequency LIKE '%TYDNE%')
  AND l.amount = (
      SELECT MIN(l2.amount)
      FROM loan AS l2
      WHERE l2.status = 'A'
        AND (substr(l2.date, 1, 4) = '1997' OR substr(l2.date, 1, 2) = '97')
  )
ORDER BY a.account_id;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account AS a
JOIN loan AS l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 12
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
  AND l.amount = (
      SELECT MAX(l2.amount)
      FROM account AS a2
      JOIN loan AS l2 ON a2.account_id = l2.account_id
      WHERE l2.duration > 12
        AND STRFTIME('%Y', a2.date) = '1993'
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client AS c
JOIN district AS d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp AS dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account AS a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
  AND d.A2 = 'Sokolov';

    FROM trans

WHERE m.label NOT IN ('+', '1', 'true', 'carcinogenic', 'active', 'yes', 't')
  AND (LOWER(a.element) = 'cl' OR LOWER(a.element) = 'chlorine');

WITH single_bonded_molecules AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id
  FROM molecule m
  WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND LOWER(b.bond_type) IN ('single', '1')
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bond b
    WHERE b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND (b.bond_type IS NULL OR LOWER(b.bond_type) NOT IN ('single', '1'))
  )
),
oxygen_counts AS (
  SELECT sbm.molecule_id,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN UPPER(a.element) IN ('O', 'OXYGEN') THEN 1 END) AS oxygen_count
  FROM single_bonded_molecules sbm
  LEFT JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = sbm.molecule_id
  GROUP BY sbm.molecule_id
)
SELECT AVG(oxygen_count) AS average_oxygen_atoms
FROM oxygen_counts;

SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS avg_single_bonds
FROM (
  SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id) AS single_bond_count
  FROM molecule m

WITH bond_order AS (
    SELECT
        bond_id,
        CASE LOWER(bond_type)
            WHEN 'single' THEN 1
            WHEN 'double' THEN 2
            WHEN 'triple' THEN 3
            WHEN 'aromatic' THEN 1.5
            WHEN '1' THEN 1
            WHEN '2' THEN 2
            WHEN '3' THEN 3
            WHEN '4' THEN 1.5
            ELSE 1
        END AS ord
    FROM bond
    WHERE molecule_id = 'TR206'
),
bond_ends AS (
    SELECT
        b.bond_id,
        bo.ord,
        MIN(c.atom_id) AS u,
        MAX(c.atom_id) AS v
    FROM bond b
    JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
    JOIN bond_order bo ON bo.bond_id = b.bond_id
    WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR206'
    GROUP BY b.bond_id, bo.ord
),
heavy_bonds AS (
    SELECT be.u AS atom_id, be.ord AS w
    FROM bond_ends be
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = be.u
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = be.v
    WHERE UPPER(a1.element) <> 'H' AND UPPER(a2.element) <> 'H'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT be.v AS atom_id, be.ord AS w
    FROM bond_ends be
    JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = be.u
    JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = be.v
    WHERE UPPER(a1.element) <> 'H' AND UPPER(a2.element) <> 'H'
),
heavy_deg AS (
    SELECT a.atom_id, COALESCE(SUM(hb.w), 0) AS deg
    FROM atom a
    LEFT JOIN heavy_bonds hb ON hb.atom_id = a.atom_id
    WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR206' AND UPPER(a.element) <> 'H'
    GROUP BY a.atom_id
),
heavy_valence AS (
    SELECT a.atom_id,
        CASE UPPER(a.element)
            WHEN 'C' THEN 4
            WHEN 'N' THEN 3
            WHEN 'O' THEN 2
            WHEN 'S' THEN 2
            WHEN 'P' THEN 3
            WHEN 'F' THEN 1
            WHEN 'CL' THEN 1
            WHEN 'BR' THEN 1
            WHEN 'I' THEN 1
            WHEN 'B' THEN 3
            ELSE 0
        END AS val
    FROM atom a
    WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR206' AND UPPER(a.element) <> 'H'
),
totals AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(MAX(0, hv.val - COALESCE(hd.deg, 0))), 0) AS total_h
    FROM heavy_valence hv
    LEFT JOIN heavy_deg hd ON hd.atom_id = hv.atom_id
),
explicit AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS explicit_h
    FROM atom
    WHERE molecule_id = 'TR206' AND UPPER(element) = 'H'
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * e.explicit_h / NULLIF(t.total_h, 0), 4) AS percentage
FROM explicit e CROSS JOIN totals t;

WITH bond_elements AS (

),

    SELECT
        bond_id,
        CASE WHEN e1 <= e2 THEN e1 || '-' || e2 ELSE e2 || '-' || e1 END AS combo
    FROM bond_elements

    FROM bond_combos

          'faceConvertedManaCost', c.faceConvertedManaCost,
          'faceName', c.faceName,
          'flavorName', c.flavorName,
          'flavorText', c.flavorText,
          'frameEffects', c.frameEffects,
          'frameVersion', c.frameVersion,
          'hand', c.hand,
          'hasAlternativeDeckLimit', c.hasAlternativeDeckLimit,
          'hasContentWarning', c.hasContentWarning,
          'hasFoil', c.hasFoil,
          'hasNonFoil', c.hasNonFoil,
          'isAlternative', c.isAlternative,
          'isFullArt', c.isFullArt,
          'isOnlineOnly', c.isOnlineOnly,
          'isOversized', c.isOversized,
          'isPromo', c.isPromo,
          'isReprint', c.isReprint,
          'isReserved', c.isReserved,
          'isStarter', c.isStarter,
          'isStorySpotlight', c.isStorySpotlight,
          'isTextless', c.isTextless,
          'isTimeshifted', c.isTimeshifted,
          'keywords', c.keywords,
          'layout', c.layout,
          'leadershipSkills', c.leadershipSkills,
          'life', c.life,
          'loyalty', c.loyalty,
          'manaCost', c.manaCost,
          'mcmId', c.mcmId,
          'mcmMetaId', c.mcmMetaId,
          'mtgArenaId', c.mtgArenaId,
          'mtgjsonV4Id', c.mtgjsonV4Id,
          'mtgoFoilId', c.mtgoFoilId,
          'mtgoId', c.mtgoId,
          'multiverseId', c.multiverseId,
          'name', c.name,
          'number', c.number,
          'originalReleaseDate', c.originalReleaseDate,
          'originalText', c.originalText,
          'originalType', c.originalType,
          'otherFaceIds', c.otherFaceIds,
          'power', c.power,
          'printings', c.printings,
          'promoTypes', c.promoTypes,
          'purchaseUrls', c.purchaseUrls,
          'rarity', c.rarity,
          'scryfallId', c.scryfallId,
          'scryfallIllustrationId', c.scryfallIllustrationId,
          'scryfallOracleId', c.scryfallOracleId,
          'setCode', c.setCode,
          'side', c.side,
          'subtypes', c.subtypes,
          'supertypes', c.supertypes,

          'types', c.types,

      WHERE je.value IS NULL

WITH p AS (
  SELECT driverId
  FROM drivers
  WHERE forename = 'Paul' AND surname = 'di Resta'
),
r853 AS (
  SELECT fastestLapSpeed
  FROM results
  WHERE driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM p)
    AND raceId = 853
),
rnext AS (
  SELECT res.fastestLapSpeed
  FROM results res
  JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = res.raceId
  WHERE res.driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM p)
    AND ra.date > (SELECT date FROM races WHERE raceId = 853)
  ORDER BY ra.date, ra.raceId
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  (CAST((SELECT fastestLapSpeed FROM r853) AS REAL) -
   CAST((SELECT fastestLapSpeed FROM rnext) AS REAL)) /
  CAST((SELECT fastestLapSpeed FROM rnext) AS REAL) * 100 AS percent_faster;

      FROM results r2
      WHERE r2.driverId = r.driverId
  );

SELECT SUM(r.points) AS total_points
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton';

SELECT AVG(
  CASE
    WHEN r.fastestLapTime LIKE '%:%' THEN
      CAST(SUBSTR(r.fastestLapTime, 1, INSTR(r.fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 +
      CAST(SUBSTR(r.fastestLapTime, INSTR(r.fastestLapTime, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
    ELSE CAST(r.fastestLapTime AS REAL)
  END
) AS avg_fastest_lap_seconds
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis'
  AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND r.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL;

SELECT
  1.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN r.laps = (SELECT MAX(r2.laps) FROM results r2 WHERE r2.raceId = r.raceId) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS completion_rate
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE ra.year = 2008
  AND ra.name = 'Australian Grand Prix';

SELECT (MAX(T2.milliseconds) - MIN(T2.milliseconds)) * 100.0 / MAX(T2.milliseconds)
FROM races AS T1
JOIN results AS T2 ON T1.raceId = T2.raceId
WHERE T1.year = 2008
  AND T1.name = 'Australian Grand Prix';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM circuits WHERE location = 'Adelaide' AND country = 'Australia';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'British' AND dob > '1980-12-31';

SELECT MAX(T2.points)
FROM constructors AS T1
JOIN constructorStandings AS T2 ON T1.constructorId = T2.constructorId
WHERE T1.nationality = 'British'
GROUP BY T1.constructorId;

SELECT c.name
FROM constructorStandings cs
JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = cs.constructorId
ORDER BY cs.points DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT c.name
FROM constructors c
JOIN constructorStandings cs ON c.constructorId = cs.constructorId
WHERE cs.raceId = 291 AND cs.points = 0;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_constructors
FROM (
    SELECT c.constructorId
    FROM constructors c
    JOIN constructorResults cr ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId
    WHERE c.nationality = 'Japanese'
      AND cr.points = 0
    GROUP BY c.constructorId
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cr.raceId) = 2
) AS japanese_constructors;

SELECT DISTINCT c.name
FROM constructors c
JOIN constructorStandings cs ON c.constructorId = cs.constructorId
WHERE cs.position = 1
ORDER BY c.name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.constructorId)
FROM constructors c
JOIN results r ON r.constructorId = c.constructorId
JOIN lapTimes l ON l.raceId = r.raceId AND l.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE c.nationality = 'French' AND l.lap > 50;

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Finished' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS race_completion_percentage
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN status s ON r.statusId = s.statusId
WHERE d.nationality = 'Japanese'
  AND ra.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009;

SELECT r.year, AVG(res.milliseconds / 1000.0) AS avg_time_seconds
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE r.year < 1975
  AND res.position = 1
GROUP BY r.year
ORDER BY r.year;

SELECT DISTINCT d.forename, d.surname
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE d.dob > '1975-12-31'
  AND r.rank = 2
ORDER BY d.surname, d.forename;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'Italian' AND driverId NOT IN (SELECT driverId FROM results WHERE statusId = (SELECT statusId FROM status WHERE status = 'Finished'));

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
WHERE lt.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT res.fastestLap
FROM results res
WHERE res.raceId = (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 2009
    ORDER BY round DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
AND res.driverId = (
    SELECT driverId
    FROM driverStandings
    WHERE raceId = (
        SELECT raceId
        FROM races
        WHERE year = 2009
        ORDER BY round DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )
    ORDER BY position ASC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT AVG(CAST(r.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) AS avg_fastest_lap_speed
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE ra.year = 2009
  AND ra.name = 'Spanish Grand Prix';

SELECT r.name, r.year
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE res.position = 1
  AND res.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY res.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.dob < '1985-01-01' AND lt.lap > 50 THEN d.driverId END)
  / COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) AS percentage
FROM drivers d
JOIN lapTimes lt ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2005;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId)
FROM drivers d
JOIN lapTimes l ON d.driverId = l.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'French'
  AND l.milliseconds < 120000;
SELECT code FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'American';
SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE year = 2009;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT driverId) FROM results WHERE raceId = 18;

SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(code, ', ') AS top3_youngest_code_numbers,
       SUM(nationality = 'Dutch') AS netherlandic_drivers_count
FROM (
    SELECT code, nationality
    FROM drivers
    ORDER BY dob DESC, driverId
    LIMIT 3
);
SELECT driverRef FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Robert' AND surname = 'Kubica';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'British' AND strftime('%Y', dob) = '1980';

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS earliest_lap_time_ms
FROM drivers d
JOIN lapTimes lt ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'German'
  AND d.dob >= '1980-01-01'
  AND d.dob <= '1990-12-31'
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname
ORDER BY earliest_lap_time_ms ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT driverRef
FROM drivers
WHERE nationality = 'German'
ORDER BY dob ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT d.driverId, d.code
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN results AS r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE strftime('%Y', d.dob) = '1971'
  AND r.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM drivers d
JOIN lapTimes l ON d.driverId = l.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'Spanish'
  AND d.dob < '1982-01-01'
ORDER BY l.milliseconds DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT r.year
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT r.year
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE res.fastestLapSpeed IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY r.year
ORDER BY MIN(CAST(res.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT driverId
FROM lapTimes
WHERE lap = 1
ORDER BY milliseconds DESC
LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results r JOIN status s ON r.statusId = s.statusId WHERE r.raceId BETWEEN 50 AND 100 AND s.status = 'Disqualified';

SELECT c.location, c.lat, c.lng, COUNT(*) AS times_held
FROM circuits c
JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
WHERE c.country = 'Austria'
GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.location, c.lat, c.lng;

SELECT raceId
FROM results
WHERE position IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY raceId
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.driverRef, d.nationality, d.dob
FROM drivers d
JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE q.raceId = 23
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q2 <> '';

SELECT r.year, r.name, r.date, r.time
FROM races r
JOIN qualifying q ON q.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE q.driverId = (
    SELECT driverId
    FROM drivers
    ORDER BY dob DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
ORDER BY r.date ASC, r.round ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId)
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON d.driverId = r.driverId
JOIN status s ON r.statusId = s.statusId
WHERE d.nationality = 'American'
  AND s.status = 'Puncture';

SELECT c.name, c.url
FROM constructors c
JOIN constructorResults cr ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId
WHERE c.nationality = 'Italian'
GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, c.url
ORDER BY SUM(cr.points) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.url
FROM constructors c
JOIN results r ON c.constructorId = r.constructorId
WHERE r.position = 1
GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.url
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname
FROM lapTimes AS l
JOIN races AS r ON l.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON l.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE r.name = 'French Grand Prix'
  AND l.lap = 3
  AND l.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY l.milliseconds DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT r.name AS race, l.milliseconds
FROM lapTimes l
JOIN races r ON l.raceId = r.raceId
WHERE l.lap = 1
  AND l.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY l.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(
  CAST(substr(r.fastestLapTime, 1, instr(r.fastestLapTime, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60 +
  CAST(substr(r.fastestLapTime, instr(r.fastestLapTime, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
) AS avg_fastest_lap_time_seconds
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE ra.year = 2006
  AND ra.name = 'United States Grand Prix'
  AND r.positionOrder <= 10;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, AVG(p.milliseconds) AS avg_pit_stop_duration_ms
FROM drivers d
JOIN pitStops p ON d.driverId = p.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'German'
  AND d.dob >= '1980-01-01'
  AND d.dob <= '1985-12-31'
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname
ORDER BY avg_pit_stop_duration_ms ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS champion, r.time AS finish_time
FROM results r
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND ra.year = 2008
  AND r.positionOrder = 1;

SELECT c.constructorRef, c.url
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN constructors c ON c.constructorId = res.constructorId
WHERE r.year = 2009
  AND r.name = 'Singapore Grand Prix'
  AND res.positionOrder = 1;

SELECT forename || ' ' || surname AS fullName, dob
FROM drivers
WHERE nationality = 'Austrian'
  AND dob BETWEEN '1981-01-01' AND '1991-12-31';

SELECT forename || ' ' || surname AS fullName,
       url AS wikipediaPageLink,
       dob AS dateOfBirth
FROM drivers
WHERE nationality = 'German'
  AND strftime('%Y', dob) BETWEEN '1971' AND '1985'
ORDER BY dob DESC;

SELECT SUM(cr.points) AS score, c.name, c.nationality
FROM constructorResults cr
JOIN races r ON cr.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN constructors c ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId
WHERE r.name = 'Monaco Grand Prix'
  AND r.year BETWEEN 1980 AND 2010
GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.name, c.nationality
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(r.points) AS average_score
FROM results r
JOIN drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis'
  AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
  AND ra.name = 'Turkish Grand Prix';

SELECT AVG(race_count) AS annual_average_races
FROM (
    SELECT year, COUNT(*) AS race_count
    FROM races
    WHERE year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009
    GROUP BY year
) AS yearly_races;

SELECT nationality
FROM drivers
GROUP BY nationality
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS victories
FROM results
WHERE driverId = (
    SELECT driverId
    FROM (
        SELECT driverId, SUM(points) AS total_points
        FROM results
        GROUP BY driverId
        ORDER BY total_points DESC
        LIMIT 1 OFFSET 90
    )
)
AND position = 1;

SELECT r.name
FROM races r
JOIN results res ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE res.fastestLapSpeed IS NOT NULL
  AND res.fastestLapSpeed <> ''
ORDER BY CAST(res.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.name AS racetrack, c.location || ', ' || c.country AS full_location
FROM races r
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
ORDER BY r.date DESC, r.time DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name
FROM drivers d
JOIN qualifying q ON d.driverId = q.driverId
JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE c.name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
  AND r.year = 2008
  AND q.position = 1
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL;

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS fullName,
       d.nationality,
       r.name AS firstRace
FROM drivers d
JOIN results res ON res.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN races r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
WHERE d.driverId = (
    SELECT driverId
    FROM drivers
    WHERE driverId IN (SELECT driverId FROM results)
    ORDER BY dob DESC, driverId
    LIMIT 1
)
AND r.raceId = (
    SELECT res2.raceId
    FROM results res2
    JOIN races r2 ON r2.raceId = res2.raceId
    WHERE res2.driverId = d.driverId
    ORDER BY r2.date, r2.raceId
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM results r
JOIN status s ON r.statusId = s.statusId
WHERE s.status = 'Accident'
  AND r.driverId = (
      SELECT r2.driverId
      FROM results r2
      JOIN status s2 ON r2.statusId = s2.statusId
      JOIN races ra ON r2.raceId = ra.raceId
      WHERE s2.status = 'Accident'
        AND ra.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
      GROUP BY r2.driverId
      ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
      LIMIT 1
  );

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM results r WHERE r.driverId = d.driverId AND r.position = 1) AS wins
FROM drivers d
ORDER BY d.dob ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(milliseconds) AS longest_pit_stop_ms
FROM pitStops;

SELECT time
FROM lapTimes
WHERE milliseconds IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(p.milliseconds) AS longest_pit_stop_ms
FROM pitStops AS p
JOIN drivers AS d ON p.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton';

SELECT ps.lap
FROM pitStops ps
JOIN races r ON ps.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON ps.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2011
  AND r.name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
  AND d.forename = 'Lewis'
  AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
ORDER BY ps.stop;

SELECT drivers.forename, drivers.surname, pitStops.duration
FROM pitStops
JOIN drivers ON pitStops.driverId = drivers.driverId
JOIN races ON pitStops.raceId = races.raceId
WHERE races.year = 2011
  AND races.name = 'Australian Grand Prix';

SELECT l.time
FROM lapTimes AS l
JOIN drivers AS d ON l.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
ORDER BY l.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS full_name
FROM lapTimes AS l
JOIN drivers AS d ON l.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE l.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY l.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT lt.position
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton'
ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT MIN(lt.milliseconds)
FROM lapTimes lt
JOIN races r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE c.country = 'Austria' OR r.name = 'Austrian Grand Prix';

WITH ranked_laps AS (
    SELECT
        c.name AS circuit,
        d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver,
        r.year,
        lt.lap,
        lt.time AS lap_time,
        lt.milliseconds,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.circuitId
            ORDER BY lt.milliseconds, r.date, lt.lap
        ) AS rn
    FROM circuits c
    JOIN races r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
    JOIN lapTimes lt ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
    JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = lt.driverId
    WHERE c.country = 'Italy'
)
SELECT circuit, driver, year, lap, lap_time, milliseconds
FROM ranked_laps
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY circuit;

SELECT r.name
FROM lapTimes AS lt
JOIN races AS r ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN circuits AS c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
WHERE c.country = 'Austria'
ORDER BY lt.milliseconds ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH lap_record AS (
  SELECT l.raceId, l.driverId
  FROM lapTimes l
  JOIN races r ON r.raceId = l.raceId
  JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  WHERE c.country = 'Austria'
  ORDER BY l.milliseconds ASC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT ps.duration
FROM pitStops ps
JOIN lap_record lr
  ON ps.raceId = lr.raceId
 AND ps.driverId = lr.driverId;

SELECT c.lat, c.lng
FROM circuits c
JOIN races r ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
JOIN lapTimes lt ON r.raceId = lt.raceId
GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.lat, c.lng
HAVING MIN(lt.milliseconds) = 89488;

SELECT AVG(p.milliseconds) AS average_pit_stop_ms
FROM pitStops p
JOIN drivers d ON p.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton';

SELECT AVG(circuit_fastest_lap_ms) AS average_lap_time_ms
FROM (
    SELECT MIN(lt.milliseconds) AS circuit_fastest_lap_ms
    FROM circuits c
    JOIN races r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
    JOIN lapTimes lt ON lt.raceId = r.raceId
    WHERE c.country = 'Italy'
    GROUP BY c.circuitId
) AS circuit_records;

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
ORDER BY overall_rating DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT player_name, height
FROM Player
ORDER BY height DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT preferred_foot
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE potential IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY potential ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE overall_rating BETWEEN 60 AND 65 AND attacking_work_rate = 'high' AND defensive_work_rate = 'low';

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
GROUP BY player_api_id
ORDER BY MAX(crossing) DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT L.name
FROM League AS L
JOIN Match AS M ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY SUM(M.home_team_goal + M.away_team_goal) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM Team t
JOIN Match m ON t.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id
WHERE m.season LIKE '%2016%'
GROUP BY t.team_long_name
ORDER BY SUM(CASE WHEN m.home_team_goal < m.away_team_goal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT Player.player_name
FROM Player
JOIN Player_Attributes ON Player.player_api_id = Player_Attributes.player_api_id
ORDER BY Player_Attributes.penalties DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT t.team_long_name, COUNT(*) AS away_wins
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
JOIN Team t ON m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE l.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
  AND m.season LIKE '2010%'
  AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal
GROUP BY t.team_api_id, t.team_long_name
ORDER BY away_wins DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT buildUpPlaySpeed
FROM Team_Attributes
ORDER BY buildUpPlaySpeed DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT L.name
FROM `Match` M
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
  AND M.home_team_goal = M.away_team_goal
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.birthday)) AS average_age
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.sprint_speed >= 97
  AND strftime('%Y', pa.date) BETWEEN '2013' AND '2015';

SELECT l.name, COUNT(*) AS match_count
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
GROUP BY l.id, l.name
ORDER BY match_count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '2010'
  AND overall_rating > (
      SELECT AVG(overall_rating)
      FROM Player_Attributes
      WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '2010'
  )
  AND overall_rating = (
      SELECT MAX(overall_rating)
      FROM Player_Attributes
      WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '2010'
        AND overall_rating > (
            SELECT AVG(overall_rating)
            FROM Player_Attributes
            WHERE strftime('%Y', date) = '2010'
        )
  );

SELECT team_fifa_api_id
FROM Team_Attributes
WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50
  AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60;

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', TA.date) = '2012'
  AND TA.buildUpPlayPassing > (
        SELECT AVG(TA2.buildUpPlayPassing)
        FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2
        WHERE strftime('%Y', TA2.date) = '2012'
  );

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN pa.preferred_foot = 'left' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.birthday BETWEEN '1987-01-01' AND '1992-12-31';

SELECT l.name AS league_name,
       SUM(COALESCE(m.home_team_goal, 0) + COALESCE(m.away_team_goal, 0)) AS total_goals
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
GROUP BY l.id, l.name
ORDER BY total_goals ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT AVG(pa.long_shots) AS avg_long_shots
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Ahmed Samir Farag';

SELECT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY AVG(pa.heading_accuracy) DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team AS T
JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
  AND strftime('%Y', TA.date) = '2014'
  AND TA.chanceCreationPassing < (
      SELECT AVG(TA2.chanceCreationPassing)
      FROM Team_Attributes AS TA2
      WHERE strftime('%Y', TA2.date) = '2014'
  )
ORDER BY TA.chanceCreationPassing DESC;

SELECT l.name
FROM `Match` m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.season = '2009/2010'
GROUP BY l.id, l.name
HAVING AVG(m.home_team_goal) > AVG(m.away_team_goal);
SELECT team_short_name FROM Team WHERE team_long_name = 'Queens Park Rangers';

SELECT player_name
FROM Player
WHERE strftime('%Y', birthday) = '1970'
  AND strftime('%m', birthday) = '10';

SELECT pa.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Franco Zennaro';

SELECT Team_Attributes.buildUpPlayPositioningClass
FROM Team
JOIN Team_Attributes ON Team.team_api_id = Team_Attributes.team_api_id
WHERE Team.team_long_name = 'ADO Den Haag';

SELECT pa.heading_accuracy
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Francois Affolter'
  AND substr(pa.date, 1, 10) = '2014-09-18';

SELECT pa.overall_rating
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Gabriel Tamas'
  AND strftime('%Y', pa.date) = '2011';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE l.name = 'Scotland Premier League'
  AND m.season = '2015/2016';

SELECT pa.preferred_foot
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
ORDER BY p.birthday DESC, pa.date DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name

WITH male_admission_counts AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(Admission) LIKE 'i%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_male,

  FROM Patient
  WHERE LOWER(SEX) LIKE 'm%'
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN inpatient_male > outpatient_male THEN 'in-patient'
    WHEN outpatient_male > inpatient_male THEN 'outpatient'
    ELSE 'tie'
  END AS more_group,
  inpatient_male,
  outpatient_male,

FROM male_admission_counts;

JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE (l.GLU < 70 OR l.GLU > 110)
  AND l.`T-CHO` BETWEEN 120 AND 220;

SELECT P.ID, L.GLU
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', P."First Date") = '1991'
  AND L.GLU BETWEEN 70 AND 110;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.WBC < 4 OR L.WBC > 10
ORDER BY P.SEX, P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT
  P.ID,
  CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(P.Birthday)) / 365.25 AS INTEGER) AS age,
  P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.RBC = (SELECT MIN(RBC) FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY P.ID;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.Admission
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE LOWER(P.SEX) IN ('f', 'female')
  AND (julianday('now') - julianday(P.Birthday)) / 365.25 >= 50
  AND (L.RBC < 3.8 OR L.RBC > 5.0);

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE LOWER(p.Admission) = 'outpatient'
  AND l.HGB < 12;

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND l.HGB >= 12
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT P.ID,
       strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient P
WHERE P.ID IN (
    SELECT L.ID
    FROM Laboratory L
    WHERE L.HCT > 50
    GROUP BY L.ID
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
);
SELECT AVG(HCT) FROM Laboratory WHERE strftime('%Y', Date) = '1991' AND HCT < 36;

SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PLT < 150 THEN ID END) AS lower_than_normal,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN ID END) AS higher_than_normal
FROM Laboratory;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', Laboratory.Date) = '1984'
  AND CAST(strftime('%Y', Laboratory.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 50
  AND Laboratory.PLT BETWEEN 150 AND 400
ORDER BY Patient.ID;

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(
  CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory L
    WHERE L.ID = P.ID
      AND L.PT > 14
  ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Patient P
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND (
    (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday))
    - (strftime('%m-%d', 'now') < strftime('%m-%d', P.Birthday))
  ) > 55;

SELECT DISTINCT P.*
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.`First Date` > '1992-12-31'
  AND L.PT BETWEEN 11 AND 13.5;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID)
FROM Laboratory L
WHERE L.APTT > 35
  AND L.ID NOT IN (
      SELECT E.ID
      FROM Examination E
      WHERE E.Thrombosis = 1
  );

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient p
WHERE LOWER(p.SEX) IN ('m', 'male')
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.WBC BETWEEN 4 AND 10
  )
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND (l.FG < 200 OR l.FG > 400)
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (L.FG < 200 OR L.FG > 400);

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`U-PRO` IS NOT NULL
  AND L.`U-PRO` <> '-';

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND TRIM(l.`U-PRO`) IN ('(-)', '-', 'normal', 'negative', 'Neg')
ORDER BY p.ID;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG > 1800;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.IGG BETWEEN 700 AND 1600
  AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(e.Symptoms) <> '';

SELECT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.IGA BETWEEN 70 AND 400
ORDER BY l.IGA DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.IGA BETWEEN 110 AND 410
  AND P.`First Date` > '1990-01-01';

SELECT p.Diagnosis
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.IGM < 50 OR l.IGM > 300
GROUP BY p.Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID)
FROM Laboratory L
WHERE L.CRP IS NOT NULL
  AND LOWER(L.CRP) NOT IN ('negative', 'normal', '-', '0', 'none')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination E
      WHERE E.ID = L.ID
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE (l.CRE < 0.6 OR l.CRE > 1.2)
  AND date(p.Birthday, '+70 years') > date('now');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RF = 'normal'
  AND (
        Examination.KCT = 'positive'
     OR Examination.RVVT = 'positive'
     OR Examination.LAC = 'positive'
  );

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday > '1985-01-01' AND T2.RF = '-';

SELECT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RF = 'normal'
  AND Patient.Birthday < date('now', '-60 years');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RF = 'normal'
  AND Examination.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID)
FROM Examination e
WHERE e.`ANA Pattern` = 'P'
  AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Laboratory l
        WHERE l.ID = e.ID
          AND l.C3 >= 90
  );

SELECT E.ID
FROM Examination AS E
WHERE E.ID IN (
    SELECT L.ID
    FROM Laboratory AS L
    WHERE L.HCT < 35 OR L.HCT > 45
)
ORDER BY E.`aCL IgG` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON p.ID = e.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis = 1
  AND l.C4 BETWEEN 10 AND 40;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.RNP = 'normal'
  AND P.Admission = '1';

SELECT P.Birthday
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.RNP IS NOT NULL
  AND LOWER(TRIM(L.RNP)) NOT IN ('normal', 'negative', '(-)', '-', '0', 'none', 'not detected')
ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID)
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Examination AS e ON l.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.SM = 'normal' AND e.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SM NOT IN ('negative', '-', 'normal', '0', 'neg', 'none')
ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT e.ID
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE e.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND l.SC170 = 'normal';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
INNER JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND L.SC170 = 'negative'
  AND E.Symptoms = 'None';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.SSA = 'normal'
  AND P.`First Date` < '2000-01-01';

SELECT p.ID
FROM Patient p
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM Laboratory l
  WHERE l.ID = p.ID
    AND l.SSA = '+'
)
ORDER BY p.`First Date`, p.ID
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination e
    WHERE e.ID = p.ID
      AND e.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.SSB = 'normal'
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.SSB = 'normal'
  AND E.Symptoms IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.CENTROMEA = '-'
  AND L.SSB = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.DNA = 'abnormal';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID)
FROM Laboratory L
LEFT JOIN Examination E ON L.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.DNA = 'normal'
  AND E.ID IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.IGG BETWEEN 800 AND 1800
  AND P.Admission = '1';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.GOT BETWEEN 0 AND 40;

SELECT MAX(P.Birthday)
FROM Patient AS P
WHERE P.ID IN (
    SELECT L.ID
    FROM Laboratory AS L
    WHERE L.GOT > 40
);

SELECT p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN (
    SELECT ID, MAX(GPT) AS max_gpt
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE GPT <= 40
    GROUP BY ID
) l ON p.ID = l.ID
ORDER BY l.max_gpt DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M'
  AND ID IN (
      SELECT ID
      FROM Laboratory
      WHERE GPT <= 40
  );

SELECT `First Date`
FROM Patient
WHERE ID = (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE LDH BETWEEN 100 AND 200
    ORDER BY LDH DESC
    LIMIT 1
);
SELECT MAX(Date) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH > 220;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE (l.ALP < 30 OR l.ALP > 120)
  AND p.Admission IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Admission = 'Outpatient'
  AND T2.ALP BETWEEN 100 AND 325;

SELECT DISTINCT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TP < 6.5;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
  AND L.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.0;

SELECT `Examination Date`
FROM Examination
WHERE ID = (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Laboratory
    WHERE ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.0
    ORDER BY ALB DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.0
  AND L.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.0;

SELECT E.`aCL IgG`
FROM Examination E
WHERE E.ID = (
    SELECT L.ID
    FROM Laboratory L
    JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
    WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
      AND L.UA BETWEEN 2.4 AND 6.0
    ORDER BY L.UA DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT MAX(E.ANA)
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON E.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.CRE <= 1.2;

SELECT P.ID
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.CRE BETWEEN 0.6 AND 1.2
ORDER BY E.`aCL IgG` DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.`T-BIL` > 1.2
)
AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination e
    WHERE e.ID = p.ID
      AND LOWER(e.`ANA Pattern`) LIKE '%peripheral%'
);

SELECT e.ANA
FROM Examination e
WHERE e.ID = (
    SELECT l.ID
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.`T-BIL` <= 1.2
    ORDER BY l.`T-BIL` DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.`T-CHO` > 200
  AND e.KCT = 'negative';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID)
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-CHO` BETWEEN 150 AND 219
  AND e.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination AS e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.TG < 150
  AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(e.Symptoms) NOT IN ('', '0', 'No', 'None', 'no', 'none');

SELECT P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TG BETWEEN 0 AND 150
ORDER BY L.TG DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Examination.Thrombosis = 0
  AND Laboratory.CPK > 200;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE L.CPK BETWEEN 20 AND 200
  AND LOWER(E.LAC) = 'positive';

SELECT MIN(P.Birthday)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GLU < 70 OR L.GLU > 110;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.GLU BETWEEN 70 AND 110
  AND e.Thrombosis = 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Admission = '1'
  AND T2.WBC BETWEEN 4 AND 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND L.WBC BETWEEN 4.0 AND 10.0;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE (L.RBC < 3.5 OR L.RBC > 5.5)
  AND P.Admission = 'Outpatient';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
INNER JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE T2.PLT BETWEEN 150 AND 400
  AND T3.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
  AND T3.Symptoms <> 'None';

SELECT L.PLT
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'MCTD'
  AND (L.PLT BETWEEN 15 AND 40 OR L.PLT BETWEEN 150 AND 400);

SELECT AVG(L.PT)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.PT BETWEEN 11 AND 13.5;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis = 1
  AND l.PT BETWEEN 11 AND 13.5;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id)

JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id)

          4

        || '-' ||
        printf('%02d', CAST(substr(event_date, 1, instr(event_date, '/') - 1) AS INTEGER))
        || '-' ||
        printf('%02d', CAST(
          substr(
            substr(event_date, instr(event_date, '/') + 1),
            1,
            instr(substr(event_date, instr(event_date, '/') + 1), '/') - 1

WITH customer_2013 AS (
    SELECT
        c.CustomerID,
        c.Segment,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption,
        AVG(y.Consumption) AS annual_avg_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY Segment
            ORDER BY total_consumption ASC, CustomerID ASC
        ) AS rn
    FROM customer_2013
),
least_consumers AS (
    SELECT Segment, annual_avg_consumption
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn = 1
),
pivot AS (
    SELECT
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) AS sme_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) AS lam_avg,
        MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg_consumption END) AS kam_avg
    FROM least_consumers
)
SELECT
    sme_avg - lam_avg AS sme_lam_difference,
    lam_avg - kam_avg AS lam_kam_difference,
    kam_avg - sme_avg AS kam_sme_difference
FROM pivot;

WITH seg AS (
  SELECT
    c.Segment,
    SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
    SUM(CASE WHEN substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
  FROM customers AS c
  JOIN yearmonth AS y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    AND substr(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
  GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
  SELECT
    Segment,
    (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) * 100.0 / consumption_2012 AS percentage_increase
  FROM seg
)
SELECT Segment
FROM pct
WHERE percentage_increase = (SELECT MAX(percentage_increase) FROM pct)
   OR percentage_increase = (SELECT MIN(percentage_increase) FROM pct);
